sharedNotes: Use separate configuration strategies per block family instead of one generic prompt/config pass.
Do not redesign the overall flow structure unless the caller explicitly asks for structural changes.

notes: Focus on block-specific configuration such as model choice, prompt text, output mode, and required config fields.
When reflection shows timing problems, feed those notes back into the matching block strategy on the next pass.
When reflection shows observability problems, feed those notes back into the matching block strategy on the next pass.

strategyDirectives.note: Model choice, prompt text, and output mode should stay aligned with the user request.
Feed reflection notes about timing back into this strategy on the next pass.
Feed reflection notes about observability and review visibility back into this strategy on the next pass.
